vb_textbox.text: I found that purple was a good hat to choose in the first round, until it came to about 3 quarters of the way and then the rules seemed to change so I switched things up and did the opposite of what I did before. The purple for me seemed to be a sure thing until that point. The brown was the same, I also found that green was better than red, but then that changed aswell. Pink is usually terrible but the other option isn't much better either. Basically keep your fingers on the correct keys and be fast because they aren't joking about the speed of the game. I found i kept forgetting to press space so bear that in mind!
